Maya: Quick operational note for the cycle 1: we need a consistent evidence package for every reviewer. I put together a short checklist and suggested filenames below so calibration reviewers can scan quickly. :memo:

Alex: Nice, thanks. Is this guidance for ICs only or should managers add evaluation notes too?

Maya: Both. Employees upload the artifacts; managers add a 1-2 sentence annotation per competency (what they observed and why). Keep annotations terse.

Jordan: If the work was cross-functional (PM/designer), do we upload partner docs?

Maya: Yes — include partner docs that add context (specs, prioritization notes, PM postmortems). Redact private comments if necessary. The goal is to capture impact, scope, and your role.

Sam: Upload path: Console > Performance > Evidence Upload (https://console.redwood.ai/performance/evidence). Set visibility to "team" only. Evidence window closes 72 hours from this message; manager annotations due end of next week.

Alex: File format? Prefer PDFs, links, or something else?

Maya: Links are fine (Chrome recordings, GitHub PRs). If attaching files use short filenames. Suggested pattern: lastname_firstname-role-project-evidence-YYYY-MM-DD.ext

Maya: Example filenames:
  park_maya-engineer-simcache-demo-2026-03-23.mp4
  chen_alex-manager-data-pipeline-brief-2026-03-23.pdf

Maya: Per artifact include:
  - 1-line description
  - your role and approximate % contribution
  - link or attachment
  - 1-sentence mapping to the competency (e.g., "led design, resulted in 40% latency reduction -> Ownership")

Maya: Expectation: 1-3 artifacts per rated competency or 3-5 artifacts total showing breadth + depth. If you only have one major artifact, add a short synthesis note listing observed behaviors.

Jordan: How should we handle customer-sensitive material?

Sam: Redact PII/PHI and customer identifiers. If something is under NDA or embargoed, include a short summary and ping me privately; we'll route it to the calibration panel with restricted access.

Alex: Are peer shoutouts acceptable as evidence?

Maya: Peer feedback is useful, include it as attachments or screenshots (blur personal contact info). Make sure peer feedback is explicit about the contribution, not just "great work."

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Evidence upload window closes in 72 hours. Managers: confirm annotation plan within 48 hours.

Maya: We'll do a 20% sample spot-check after uploads close. If artifacts are missing or unclear, managers will be asked to follow up. For edge cases (contractor scope, cross-org initiatives, promotions in-flight) drop here or DM Sam. :eyes:
